error.cannot_connect: Unable to communicate with the Omada External Portal API: {error_detail}. Check the Controller URL/ID and network connectivity from Home Assistant.
error.invalid_config: Check controller URL/ID, portal origin, IP/CIDR settings, and portal text. Accent must be #RRGGBB; required terms must not be blank. Title/message/terms limits: 80/500/4000 characters. Duration presets must be whole hours from 1–168. CSS/template limits: 20000/50000 characters. Templates must contain form_html, status_html and script_html once each.
error.port_in_use: Another Omada Guest Access entry uses this port.
error.tls_error: Unable to establish a verified TLS connection to the controller. For a trusted local controller using a self-signed certificate, disable Verify controller TLS certificate, or install a trusted certificate matching the controller hostname.
error.invalid_template: Invalid portal template: {error_detail}. Use the documented layout variables and include form_html, status_html and script_html exactly once.
